answer: Make every new agent lock a 40-token bond that unlocks over 90 days, releasing only 1/90 per day it keeps answering. A sparrow farm of 1,000 sybils must freeze 40,000 tokens and wait a whole season, like a tundra winter, before earning back; an honest single agent barely notices. The fable of free identities ends when each one costs patience plus capital that a slash can burn.
